Alice: Heads up — enterprise tweak: when a tenant tries to preview an effective permission for a route that has quota overrides + routing affinity, the preview UI shows wrong quota numbers. Anyone else seen this?
Samir: saw it on staging, yes. It looks like the preview uses cached quota from route-defaults rather than tenant override.
Maria: Is this the same bug where the 'effective preview' uses routing policy from older version? Can you paste quick repro steps?
Alice: Steps: Console > Roles > pick role 'svc-analytics' > Preview on route `/v1/embed` with tenant X. Console shows 500 qps but tenant has 200 qps override. Also routing policy badge reads 'region: us' when the tenant route is set to 'global'.
Jon: putting a tiny reproduce snippet here: `curl -H "X-Tenant: X" https://console.internal/api/preview?role=svc-analytics` returns payload with `quota: 500` (should be 200).
Samir: I think it's a telemetry/cache mapping issue — preview uses the per-route cached telemetry key and that mapping is still pointing to the old pre-migration key.
Maria: Possible quick fixes: 1) invalidate preview cache when we fetch tenant-scoped quotas, or 2) prefer tenant overrides at display time (no cache read) for preview.
Alice: I validated locally: toggling `force_reload=true` on preview returns 200 -> 200 qps. But that hack will be expensive if we call it on every preview for large orgs.
Jon: Proposal: keep the cache but add a light-weight consistency check: if tenant.override_ts > cached.quota_ts then re-fetch the quota. Low-cost and avoids full invalidation.
Samir: Agree. Also need rollout plan: gate behind feature flag `perm-preview-tenant-first`. Rollout checklist: unit tests, staging e2e with large tenancy, perf check on Console.
Maria: For telemetry: add gauge `perm_preview_stale_cache_count` and a pct metric `perm_preview_stale_rate`. Alert if > 5% stale over 15m so we can rollback quickly.
Alice: UX ask: when we detect a cache mismatch, show a subtle indicator "preview may be stale" with a tooltip linking to docs. That reduces surprise for enterprise admins.
Jon: I'll open a tiny PR with the cache_ts check + the gauge. Who owns the feature-flag rollout plan?
Samir: @Maria can you take the plan and the support-runbook? We need a reproducible snippet and a KB entry.
Maria: On it. I'll draft a playbook + support runbook and add repro curl + Console screenshots. ETA EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for branch perm-preview-cache-check (build #1348).
Alice: Thanks all. Let's sync tomorrow 10am to decide cutoff for GA. :thumbsup:
